proofLimit: The original process did not persist a fatal location before output creation; output:null and exact source control flow establish it stopped before output/password generation and Auth calls. The cause was isolated by subsequent read-only metadata/source checks.
scope: Harness preflight failure, not a product recovery failure.
diagnosisCorrection: The original fatal location was not retained. The later exact diagnostic demonstrates the earlier DSN empty-search assertion fails before mapped-executable checking; the launcher/mapped-executable distinction was an additional real harness constraint, not a proven first thrown location.
